list.name: ai-memory
list.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

list.name: xerj
list.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.

list.name: bun
list.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one

list.name: Konnect
list.description: AI-assisted PCB design for KiCAD 10. Native KiCAD plugin — a single Rust binary exposing 217 schematic, layout, routing, placement, design-review, and manufacturing tools to Claude, or the LLM of your choosing

list.name: OpenBitFun
list.description: OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.

list.name: Codync
list.description: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: message Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and 40+ AI agents as bots on your own computer, from iPhone, Mac, Windows, Linux or terminal. Free. Also a Muse and Dots alternative. Built in Rust.

list.name: uzu
list.description: A high-performance inference engine for AI models

list.name: cli
list.description: Google Workspace CLI — one command-line tool for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more. Dynamically built from Google Discovery Service. Includes AI agent skills.

list.name: omnigraph
list.description: Object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology

list.description: Cross-platform & feature rich iOS/iPadOS/tvOS sideloading application. Formerly known as PlumeImpactor.
